description_en: Queries the information about a specified SSL client certificate
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnClientCert接口查询指定的SSL客户端证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-client-cert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-client-cert-id vsc-bp17r58rjf5r1gjyr0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnClientCert

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SSL client certificate to query. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的SSL客户端证书所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的SSL客户端证书的ID
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_client_cert_id

ClientConfig.example:
client
dev tun
proto tcp
remote 120.XX.XX.33 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
ca ca.crt
cert vsc-bp15t7****.crt
key vsc-bp15t7****.key
cipher AES-128-CBC
;comp-lzo
verb 4

ClientKey.example:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEpAI****ZzNFhuM/za==
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the SSL client certificate was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in the Unix format, which represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC, to the time when the SSL client certificate was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书的创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建SSL客户端证书时的总时长

EndTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the SSL client certificate expires. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in the Unix format, which represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC, to the time when the SSL client certificate expires
EndTime.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书的到期时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至SSL客户端证书到期时的总时长

Name.description_en: The name of the SSL client certificate

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the SSL client certificate
RegionId.description_zh: SSL客户端证书所在的地域ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The resource group ID of the SSL client certificate.

The SSL client certificate belongs to the same resource group as its associated SSL server. You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书所属的资源组ID。

SSL客户端证书与其关联的SSL服务端的资源组相同。您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

SslVpnClientCertId.description_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate

Status.description_en:
The status of the SSL client certificate. Valid values:

expiring-soon: The certificate will expire within one week.

normal: Normal. 

expired: Expired
Status.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书的状态。

expiring-soon：证书将在1周后过期。

normal：正常。 

expired：已过期
